name: Chatbase
tagline: Build no-code AI support agents trained on your own data.
description: Chatbase is a platform for building and deploying AI customer-support agents trained on your docs, website, and files. Agents answer customer questions, take actions via integrations (Zendesk, Slack, Stripe, Salesforce, WhatsApp), and escalate complex issues to humans, with analytics over performance. It launched in early 2023 as one of the first 'ChatGPT for your website' tools and now serves thousands of businesses across 80+ languages.
